article.headline: Burch has 130 yards rushing and a TD, Buffalo beats Arkon to clinch berth in MAC title game
article.description: — Messiah Burch had 130 yards rushing and a touchdown on 24 carries, Jason Wright threw a 21-yard touchdown pass to Terrance Shelton Jr. and Buffalo beat Akron 17-9 on Friday to clinch a berth in the Mid-American Conference championship game.
article.linkText: Burch has 130 yards rushing and a TD, Buffalo beats Arkon to clinch berth in MAC title game

article.story: AKRON, Ohio -- — Messiah Burch had 130 yards rushing and a touchdown on 24 carries, Jason Wright threw a 21-yard touchdown pass to Terrance Shelton Jr. and Buffalo beat Akron 17-9 on Friday to clinch a berth in the Mid-American Conference championship game. Buffalo (9-3, 7-1 Mid-American Conference) plays Toledo for the MAC championship on Dec. 5 at Ford Field in Detroit. After the loss, Akron coach Joe Moorhead announced on social media that he is stepping down after five seasons to pursue other opportunities. Moorhead finished 15-44 at Akron. Oliver Hautanen kicked a 39-yard field goal that gave Buffalo the lead for good at 10-9 with 2:25 left in the third quarter. Akron (2-10, 1-7) answered with an 11-play, 54-yard drive that was stalled by holding penalty deep in Bulls territory before Matthew Schramm missed a 39-yard field-goal attempt early in the fourth. Burch capped the scoring with a 43-yard touchdown run with 9:58 left in the game. Up next Buffalo: Plays Toledo in the MAC championship game.
